arm_contract.episode_reset_snn: readout reset per task; both encoders fixed
arm_contract.grammar_streaming: fixed grammar order; no policy or model
arm_contract.online_nonspiking: readout learns; both encoders fixed; continuous-leaky state
arm_contract.persistent_snn: readout learns; both encoders fixed; state persists within order
arm_contract.plastic_nonspiking: readout and both encoders learn; continuous-leaky
arm_contract.plastic_snn: readout and both encoders learn; binary LIF
arm_contract.reset_plastic_snn: readout and both encoders reset per task; binary LIF

base_policy.persistent_state_scope: Readout and reward baseline persist within an order; membrane and pending credit clear at episode boundaries.

eligibility_recurrence.input_derivative: x_j for base encoder E[h,j]; h_j/18 for context projection C[j,h]
x_j for base encoder E[h,j]; h_j/18 for context projection C[j,h]

plastic_encoder.credit: six-step current-decision surrogate eligibility; no delayed reward or cross-action credit

decision_credit.context_projection_refresh: Recompute the 18x16 context projection current from updated C at each subsequent choose; account 288 multiply-accumulate operations per decision.
decision_credit.current_readout_gradient: Compute g_h with pre-observation readout W_pre before the inherited readout update; use the same g_h for both E and C updates.
decision_credit.feedback: only after executing the selected graph on the six observed rows
decision_credit.history_gradient: six steps within current choice; truncate at each choose

plastic_encoder.disabled_controls: encoder_learning=false; inherited choice, feedback, and reset behavior remain unchanged

initialization.action_rng_initialization_and_draw_order: Inherited seed and draw order; unchanged
initialization.base_encoder_E: Seeded inherited 16x6 ternary projection from OnlineSpikingPolicy; bytes initially match fixed control and receive updates only when encoder_learning=true
initialization.observed_context_projection_C: Seeded inherited 18x16 ternary projection from ObservedContextPolicy using its isolated context RNG; bytes initially match fixed control and receive updates only when encoder_learning=true
initialization.readout_initialization: Inherited zero readout and baseline; unchanged

plastic_encoder.reset_plastic_scope: restore seeded readout and both seeded encoder projections before each task without rewinding action RNG

available_to_policy: current task six observed integer (x,y,target) triples
policy_input_contract.feedback_order: Execute the selected graph on observed rows, then provide the existing reward; external held checker runs outside policy.
policy_input_contract.opaque_episode_id: Boundary validation only; never encoded or used in action/update.

reporting.memory: Report whole-process peak RSS and serialized state size only; no per-arm peak claim
reporting.scope_limit: One fixed 48-task synthetic stream repeated across orders and seeds; not evidence of generalization to new functions, real sensing, chip behavior, or energy use

retention_diagnostic.context_order: canonical frozen corpus order, independent of presented task order
retention_diagnostic.probability_calculation: evaluation_copy, fresh zero membrane, encoder forward pass, current readout logits and masked softmax over add/sub/mul; no choose/sample/observe calls
retention_diagnostic.probe_method: evaluation_copy at a policy boundary; set one task's six observed triples, run cold initial features, read probabilities without sampling or observing reward
retention_diagnostic.purpose: Measure cold root-lane preference retention, not held-solution or complete-program retention
retention_diagnostic.raw_artifact: retention.jsonl.gz; one row per order, budget, seed, neural arm, boundary, with 48 ordered context probes
retention_diagnostic.root_label_use: post-probe metadata only for root-label probability and correctness summaries

source_schedule.pairing_unit: task content identified by frozen task_id
